name_en: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY for senior citizens 70+ (Ayushman Vay Vandana Card)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
benefit: If you are 70 or older, you get free hospital care up to Rs 5 lakh a year. If your family already has PM-JAY, you get an extra Rs 5 lakh just for you.

other: There is no income limit. Rich or poor, all people 70 and above can join.
If you use CGHS, ECHS or CAPF health schemes, you must pick either that scheme or PM-JAY.
People with private health insurance or ESI can still join.

how_to_apply: Go to the nearest listed (empanelled) hospital to register. Or register yourself on the Ayushman app or at beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
where_to_apply: Nearest empanelled hospital, Ayushman app, or www.beneficiary.nha.gov.in. In Tamil Nadu, PM-JAY runs with CMCHIS (cmchistn.com).
